title: A fee bump whose inner transaction leaves a sponsorship open: inner txBAD_SPONSORSHIP
pattern: The inner transaction begins sponsoring an account and never ends it. The fee bump's result is txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED; the inner result is txBAD_SPONSORSHIP, a transaction-level code inside InnerTransactionResult. The fee source pays; nothing the inner transaction did is kept.

hazards.placement: an open sponsorship inside a fee bump

facts.says: The inner transaction fails with txBAD_SPONSORSHIP.
